t: This LAP PIR standalone sensor provides reliable motion detection for lighting control. It is suitable for both domestic and commercial installations, ideal for enhancing security around properties or automating lighting in garages and workshops. The sensor features a 180° detection angle and a 12-metre range, ensuring wide coverage. Its IP44 rating allows for indoor and outdoor use, offering versatility. Features adjustable time-on and dusk-to-dawn settings, alongside a manual override function for flexible operation. The unit is mains-powered and comes with fittings supplied for straightforward wall-mounted installation. It handles various lighting types, including incandescent, fluorescent, and LED.
